'''Crysta Markon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|The Huntmaster himself will explain how we're gonna sort things out. Head into the main room and show some respect. When the Huntmaster's done talking, come on back here. I'll be handling you from here on out.|Crysta Markon, to the Hunter|<ref name="TOR:THoDK" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> Crysta Markon worked as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] handler at the Mandalorian Enclave on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] where she met an [[Hunter (individual)|unidentified bounty hunter]] who was there to participate in the [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt]].<ref name="TOR:THoDK" /> She sent the bounty hunter on several assignments across the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in order to earn a spot in the final melee.<ref name="TOR:AMT" /><ref name="TOR:FC">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Family Cleansing|Dromund Kaas}}</ref><ref name="TOR:TSG">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Spy Game|Dromund Kaas}}</ref> After the hunter managed to win the [[Grand Melee]] and became a [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] competitor,<ref name="TOR:TM">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Melee|Dromund Kaas}}</ref> Crysta then instructed the hunter to steal a [[D5-Mantis Patrol Craft]] from the [[Dromund Kaas spaceport|spaceport]] as part of the competition. Despite interference from rival [[Tarro Blood]] alerting the spaceport authorities, the hunter was able to get away with the ship.<ref name="TOR:JR">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Joy Ride|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>

Throughout the Great Hunt, Crysta provided holorecordings with information on their assigned target.<ref name="TOR:TBT">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Balmorran Target|the D5-Mantis}}</ref><ref name="TOR:TEoME">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Enemy of My Enemy|the D5-Mantis}}</ref><ref name="TOR:TTT">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Tatooine Target|the D5-Mantis}}</ref><ref name="TOR:TAT">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Alderaan Target|the D5-Mantis}}</ref> When the hunter reached the final round, Crysta personally explained via holo that the final target was [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kellian Jarro]], known for the most [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] kills. As Jarro was stationed aboard the Republic starship, [[Aurora (Valor-class)|''Aurora'']], not only would the hunter be required to kill him, but to also disable the ship's hyperdrive regulator so that the ship would be destroyed when it jumped to hyperspace. She also tipped off the hunter that Blood had reached the ''Aurora'' first.<ref name="TOR:TMK">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Mandalorian Killer|the ''Aurora''}}</ref>

Crysta was later witness to the hunter returning to Dromund Kaas victorious and commended her friend.<ref name="TOR:HtCH">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Hail the Conquering Hero|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>

In [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Crysta sent a message to the Hunter, suggesting various planets to go to for a vacation.<ref name="TOR:Kit">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=message|Keeping in touch!|Crysta Markon}}</ref> Not long afterwards, while visiting [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], she sent a message back to her daughter [[Thera Markon]] about her travels there.<ref name="RCPoI">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20141201-0|text=Raider's Cove: Persons of Interest}}</ref> However, she was killed by the [[Kanawyn Syndicate]], leading her daughter to travel to Rishi to investigate Crysta's death.<ref name="TOR:TOLB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Crysta Markon is a flirt option for male bounty hunters.<ref name="TOR:THoDK" />
